bindings.qualification: 756 native experimental conditions; benzaldehyde is explicitly identified by the source as the main undesired by-product of styrene epoxidation. The task predicts its measured-spectrum-derived yield for a known candidate. Native fitted zero values are preserved as quantitative estimates and are not relabelled absence/not-detected. Desired-product yield and selectivity columns are excluded from model inputs. No generated candidates or interpolated viewer tables are used. One chemical transformation with a catalyst-composition panel; grouping must prevent repeated compositions crossing splits.
bindings.reference_evidence: Primary paper Figure6c–d and the 'Five-dimensional compositional space' section explicitly distinguish desired styrene oxide from benzaldehyde20b, the main by-product. Methods specify72°C/6h and UV–Vis spectral unmixing. Native summary README defines units and source CSV contains756 indexed catalyst-composition assays.

impurity_prediction.scope: One source-identified benzaldehyde side product; not an open-world impurity structure-discovery benchmark.

bindings.qualification: Selects source records with an explicitly identified impurity phase, balanced target reaction, concrete precursor and target compositions and original DOI. Native unknown/variable identities are excluded; partial known subsets are flagged. The61937 no-impurity-report cohort is never used as negative evidence. Source labels are extracted literature observations, not computationally generated candidate phases. Materials Project most-stable-entry assignments/energies are omitted from all features and references. Native synthesis operations are DOI-level context and may not map uniquely to a particular recipe, so exact condition-specific causal claims are unsupported. Original publication and reaction identity must be grouped in eventual benchmark splits.
bindings.reference_evidence: Source Data Records explicitly distinguish intended target from impurity_phase entities and retain original publication DOI. Primary Technical Validation describes source extraction, balancing and thermodynamic validation. Figsharev1 grantsCC-BY4.0 for the native80806-record structured data file.
